regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-horse leadership structure: Banks (rank 1, crowded, durable) narrowly ahead of Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, also crowded). Only 4 of 22 themes pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate, and crucially the backtest verdict says the trend gate did NOT hold on China A-shares history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so the core validated edge is absent here — this reads as an attention/focus map, not a return signal. Track record shows direction accuracy of only 0.377, so leans must be humble.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from Banks to Innovative Pharma & CXO: Banks' durability_bar (0.73) or breadth (0.889) dropping below Pharma's, with the rotation margin turning negative for 5 consecutive sessions, would retire the watch. AI Compute & Optics sits just below the eligibility gate (eligible=false, score 0.682) — if it crosses to eligible with breadth recovering from 0.059, note it as a separate early formation, not a call.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed leader with the highest score, a durable breadth (0.889), and widest participation. The momentum rank is an attention lens, not alpha, so this is a stay-with-the-confirmed-leader lean rather than a return forecast. Crowding (z=1.78, flagged) argues for sizing caution, not a fade.
evidence: crowding_z 1.78 and crowded=true — cap, do not fade
theses.dissent: Crowding at this level plus a mean-reverting tape (gate did not help historically) means the leader can correct sharply without warning — the one validated edge fails on this market, leaving only coincident read.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 3% before the 20-day check-by

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only credible challenger to Banks: eligible, rank 2 with a near-identical score (0.988), and crowding that is elevated but slightly below Banks. The rotation margin is thin (0.01), so this is not a handoff call — just keeping the challenger on the table while leadership remains contested.
theses.dissent: Narrow leadership (4 of 22 eligible) means the challenger's support is thin; a broad-risk flush would hit crowded challengers as hard as leaders, and Pharma/CXO earnings can gap on policy headlines unrelated to tape.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other non-crowded eligible theme (eligible=true, rank 6) but its hurst_tag is mean-revert with weak breadth (0.30) and middling durability (0.46). In a market where the trend gate already failed, a mean-revert-tagged eligible name offers no structural reason to commit.
theses.dissent: Value/cyclical rotation within a narrow tape could lift Coal if risk appetite broadens and the crowded leaders stall — Coal's non-crowded status makes it the least reflexive of the eligible set.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by 4% before the 20-day check-by

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
